description.value:
Rank 2 Melee Technique

  • Ki Cost: 15 Ki
  • Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Melee Weapon that you are proficient with.
  • Casting Time: When you take the Attack Action or roll a Combo Attack Roll with a qualifying Weapon
  • Range: Self
  • Chargeable?: No
  • Duration: Until the start of your next turn

You add energy to your weapon sending ki facsimiles of your attacks. For the duration of this technique your Melee Weapons gain a 30 foot range and have their Damage Type changed to Ki Damage.
